constraints.name: agent_position_deux_etats
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((leader_courant IS NOT NULL) AND (ville IS NULL)) OR (leader_courant IS NULL)))

constraints.name: ambassades_audiences_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((ambassadeur_pj IS NOT NULL) OR (accord_prevu_le IS NOT NULL)))

constraints.name: ambassades_audiences_check1
constraints.definition: CHECK (((statut = 'demandee'::text) OR ((accordee_le IS NOT NULL) AND (expire_le IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: batailles_engagements_identite
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((personnage IS NOT NULL) AND (matricule IS NULL)) OR ((personnage IS NULL) AND (matricule IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: cellule_fin_coherente
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((statut = 'active'::text) AND (mode_fin IS NULL) AND (terminee_le IS NULL)) OR ((statut <> 'active'::text) AND (mode_fin IS NOT NULL) AND (terminee_le IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: pnj_car_bornes
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((COALESCE(car_int, 0) >= 0) AND (COALESCE(car_int, 0) <= 100)) AND ((COALESCE(car_cha, 0) >= 0) AND (COALESCE(car_cha, 0) <= 100)) AND ((COALESCE(car_vol, 0) >= 0) AND (COALESCE(car_vol, 0) <= 100)) AND ((COALESCE(car_per, 0) >= 0) AND (COALESCE(car_per, 0) <= 100)) AND ((COALESCE(car_dup, 0) >= 0) AND (COALESCE(car_dup, 0) <= 100)) AND ((COALESCE(car_ent, 0) >= 0) AND (COALESCE(car_ent, 0) <= 100))))

constraints.name: pnj_mort_sans_leader
constraints.definition: CHECK (((statut <> 'mort'::text) OR ((leader_pj IS NULL) AND (leader_pnj_id IS NULL))))

constraints.name: pnj_position_deux_etats
constraints.definition: CHECK (((((leader_pj IS NOT NULL) OR (leader_pnj_id IS NOT NULL)) AND (ville IS NULL) AND (building_id IS NULL) AND (room_id IS NULL) AND (rue_noeud_id IS NULL)) OR ((leader_pj IS NULL) AND (leader_pnj_id IS NULL))))

constraints.name: pnj_propriete_exclusive
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((classe = 'gamma'::text) AND (proprietaire_pj IS NULL) AND (proprietaire_institution IS NULL) AND (proprietaire_perimetre IS NULL)) OR ((classe IS DISTINCT FROM 'gamma'::text) AND (((proprietaire_pj IS NOT NULL) AND (proprietaire_institution IS NULL) AND (proprietaire_perimetre IS NULL)) OR ((proprietaire_pj IS NULL) AND (proprietaire_institution IS NOT NULL) AND (proprietaire_perimetre IS NOT NULL))))))

constraints.name: pnj_un_seul_leader
constraints.definition: CHECK (((leader_pj IS NULL) OR (leader_pnj_id IS NULL)))

constraints.name: pnj_soldats_compteurs_bien_formes
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((dernier_ration IS NULL) OR (dernier_ration ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$'::text)) AND ((dernier_bivouac IS NULL) OR (dernier_bivouac ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$'::text)) AND ((dernier_sommeil IS NULL) OR (dernier_sommeil ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$'::text)) AND ((nb_ration IS NULL) OR (nb_ration >= 0))))

constraints.name: pnj_soldats_section_dans_sa_compagnie
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((en_reserve = true) AND (section_id IS NULL)) OR ((en_reserve = false) AND (section_id IS NOT NULL) AND ((compagnie_id IS NULL) OR (section_id ~~ (compagnie_id || '-%'::text))))))

constraints.name: serrures_armoire_objet
constraints.definition: CHECK (((cible IS DISTINCT FROM 'armoire'::text) OR (armoire_objet IS NOT NULL)))

constraints.name: serrures_lieu_bail
constraints.definition: CHECK (((cible IS DISTINCT FROM 'lieu'::text) OR ((bail_ref IS NOT NULL) AND (bail_titulaire IS NOT NULL))))
